intro_card.text: Long ago, people and kith lived side by side, bound by a promise called the Accord.
Then came the Sundering. The Accord broke, the kith fled into the wild places, and trust turned to fear.
Now only the Wardens keep the old ways — earning a kith's trust, one bond at a time.
In the village of Mossford, at the edge of the Glimmerwood, an apprentice wakes on the morning of the Kindling...

player_house.text: Your home. The kettle's still warm. No time for tea today — it's the Kindling!

notice_board.text: THE KINDLING — today, at the Ringstones.
Apprentices: earn the trust of a wild kith before sundown, then prove your bond in the duel. By order of the Wardens of Mossford.

well.text: The old village well. Someone has carved "C + BISCUIT" into the stone. The scratches look very fresh.

signpost.text: West: the Glimmerwood.  North: the Dawn Shrine.  East: the training grounds.  North-east: the Ringstones.

hesper_intro.speaker: Hesper
hesper_intro.text: There you are, {player}! I was about to send Lumen to drag you out of bed by your ear.

hesper_intro.speaker: Hesper
hesper_intro.text: Today is the Kindling. Every apprentice must earn the trust of a wild kith — and prove that bond at the Ringstones before sundown.

hesper_intro.speaker: Hesper
hesper_intro.text: Trust, mind you. Not nets, not cages, not bribes. A kith that follows you out of fear isn't bound to you. It's just waiting to leave.

hesper_intro.speaker: Hesper
hesper_intro.text: Something has the forest kith spooked lately. Folk have found iron snares in the Glimmerwood, marked with strange burnt-in signs.

reply.speaker: Hesper
reply.text: Someone who's forgotten what the Accord was for. Keep your eyes open out there.

reply.speaker: Hesper
reply.text: Careful and curious. That's the Warden way.

corin_intro.speaker: Corin
corin_intro.text: {player}! You're up! Look — LOOK — who followed me home!

corin_intro.speaker: Corin
corin_intro.text: Found this big lump asleep in the riverbed at dawn. I sat with him for an hour, he yawned at me, and now he won't leave me alone. His name's Biscuit.

corin_intro.speaker: Hesper
corin_intro.text: A Stoneback. Stubborn, sleepy and loyal to the bone. You two deserve each other.

corin_intro.speaker: Corin
corin_intro.text: We're going to win the Kindling duel. No offense, {player}, but you haven't even got a kith yet!

corin_intro.speaker: Corin
corin_intro.text: I'll be waiting at the Ringstones. Don't take so long that Biscuit falls asleep again!

hesper_send_off.speaker: Hesper
hesper_send_off.text: Go on, then. Try the Glimmerwood — west, across the bridge.

hesper_send_off.speaker: Hesper
hesper_send_off.text: Move softly near wild kith. They hear running feet from across a meadow. Hold [b]Shift[/b] to sneak.

hesper_send_off.speaker: Hesper
hesper_send_off.text: And take this. Every Warden carries a flame — you'll know when you need it.

hesper_idle_find.speaker: Hesper
hesper_idle_find.text: The Glimmerwood is west, over the bridge. Softly, now.

baker.speaker: Wynn
baker.text: Morning, {player}! Big day! Here's a baker's secret about the little fire-tailed kith in the woods...

baker.speaker: Wynn
baker.text: A cold Emberlyn is a scared Emberlyn. Warm one up and it'll purr like my oven.

baker_after.speaker: Wynn
baker_after.text: Oh, look at its little tail glow! Go on, show it off at the Ringstones!

farmer.speaker: Bram
farmer.text: Hmph. Something's been nibbling my clover again. Mosslings, out in the north meadow.

farmer.speaker: Bram
farmer.text: You'll never get near one. They bolt if you so much as stomp. Unless you creep like a cat — ha! As if apprentices know how to creep.

forest_arrival.text: A small kith peers out of a hollow log. Its tail ember sputters, barely alive.
It sees you — and shrinks back into the dark, trembling.

emberlyn_spooked.text: It ducks back into the log. Too loud. Try approaching softly (hold [b]Shift[/b]).

observe_emberlyn.text: You kneel and keep still, and watch.
It's shivering. The forest floor is soaked from last night's rain, and its ember is guttering in the cold.
It needs warmth. Dry kindlemoss grows on old stumps and stones around the clearing — and there's an old fire ring nearby.

snare.text: A broken iron snare, its jaws snapped shut on nothing. A sigil is scorched into the metal.
It's still faintly warm. Whatever it caught got away... leaving a few singed russet hairs behind.

fire_ring_empty.text: An old ring of fire-blackened stones. You'll need something dry to burn.

fire_lit.text: You pile the kindlemoss in the stone ring and touch it with your Warden's Lantern...
Warm light spills across the clearing.

sit_down.text: You sit by the fire and keep very, very still...

sit_moved.text: It skitters back to the log. Patience — stay still and let it come to you.

emberlyn_close.text: It creeps out, step by step, and curls up beside the fire. Its ember is brightening.
Slowly, offer your hand. (Press when the rings meet.)

offer_fail.text: It flinches at the sudden movement. Breathe, and try again.

befriended.text: Emberlyn sniffs your fingers... then presses its warm little head into your palm.

hesper_training_intro.speaker: Hesper
hesper_training_intro.text: Well, look at that. An Emberlyn! And it chose you — I can tell by the way that ember's burning.

hesper_training_intro.speaker: Hesper
hesper_training_intro.text: Bonding is half the work. The other half is learning to fight beside it. Beside it, mind — never as if it were a sword.

hesper_training_intro.speaker: Hesper
hesper_training_intro.text: In a duel, you guide your kith directly. Into the yard with you. Lumen will mind the training totem.

hesper_training_snare.speaker: Hesper
hesper_training_snare.text: A sigil burnt into a snare, you say? ...I'll look into it. Focus on today.

hesper_after_training.speaker: Hesper
hesper_after_training.text: Not bad at all, Sprout. Emberlyn is quick, but fragile. Don't trade blows with heavy hitters — dash through them, strike, slip away.

hesper_after_training.speaker: Hesper
hesper_after_training.text: And when you're winded, find a safe moment to Focus. A Warden who runs dry is a Warden who gets flattened.

hesper_after_training.speaker: Hesper
hesper_after_training.text: Corin's waiting at the Ringstones — north-east of the meadow. The whole village is heading over. Go on, I'll be right behind you.

corin_duel.speaker: Corin
corin_duel.text: There you are! And you've got an EMBERLYN! Okay. Okay okay okay. This is going to be good.

corin_duel.speaker: Corin
corin_duel.text: Biscuit's slow, but he hits like a landslide. And he's basically a wall. Don't say I didn't warn you!

corin_duel.speaker: Hesper
corin_duel.text: Apprentices! The Kindling duel is to the first knockout. Wardens fight with their kith's trust, not their own pride.

corin_waiting.speaker: Corin
corin_waiting.text: Ready for a rematch? Biscuit's been practising his scowl.

duel_won.speaker: Corin
duel_won.text: Augh! You were everywhere! Biscuit, did you see that? ...He's asleep.

duel_won.speaker: Corin
duel_won.text: Fine. FINE! Good duel, {player}. Next time I'm winning.

duel_won.speaker: Hesper
duel_won.text: By the old Accord, I name you both Wardens of Mossford. Wear the ember with pride.

duel_lost.speaker: Corin
duel_lost.text: Ha! Biscuit, we did it! ...Hey, don't look so glum, {player}. That was close.

duel_lost.speaker: Hesper
duel_lost.text: The bond isn't measured by one fall. Catch your breath and try again when you're ready.

choices.text: Again — but go a little easier on me.

tremor.speaker: Corin
tremor.text: The ground — it's coming from the north. From the old shrine!

tremor.speaker: Hesper
tremor.text: Everyone stay here. {player}, Corin — with me. Now.

shrine_arrival.speaker: Hesper
shrine_arrival.text: The Dawn Shrine... I haven't seen the mural glow since I was younger than you.

shrine_arrival.speaker: Hesper
shrine_arrival.text: That's Aurelune, the Dawncrane. The old songs say it sealed the Accord between people and kith — and vanished the day the Accord broke.

shrine_ember.speaker: Corin
shrine_ember.text: {player}, your Emberlyn's ember is glowing just like the mural! What does that mean?

shrine_ember.speaker: Hesper
shrine_ember.text: It means it's answering something. Something old.

sigilbinder_seen.speaker: Hesper
sigilbinder_seen.text: A sigil-chain... Sigilbinders. I'd hoped they were only a story we told to frighten apprentices.

sigilbinder_seen.speaker: Hesper
sigilbinder_seen.text: Those snares in the forest weren't catching kith at random. They were hunting for this. For Aurelune.

sigilbinder_seen.speaker: Hesper
sigilbinder_seen.text: Get some rest, Wardens. Tomorrow, we have a long road ahead.

mossling_observed.text: The Mossling's ears twitch. It sniffs the air in your direction... and goes back to nibbling clover. It isn't afraid of you.

lanternmoth.text: Lumen, Hesper's Lanternmoth, flutters a lazy circle around your head. Its glow is warm, like a lamp left on for you.

arena_gate_early.text: The Ringstones — an old circle of standing stones where Wardens have dueled for generations. Corin is pacing inside.

arena_gate_early.speaker: Corin
arena_gate_early.text: Not yet! You need a kith first, {player}! And Hesper says you have to train!

training_gate_early.text: The training yard. Straw totems stand in a neat row, waiting to be whacked.

shrine_early.text: The Dawn Shrine: crumbling walls, and an ancient mural of a great crane-like kith spreading its wings before a rising sun.
Hesper says the shrine is older than Mossford itself.
